messages:
Maya: Need a compact benchmark narrative for next Tues webinar. Scope: latency vs token cost across 3 customer workloads. Goal: 1 one-pager + 3 visuals + 2 social post tones + routing playbook. Owner asks?
Ethan: I9ll run the data. Suggested visuals: waterfall (P50/P95/P99) by variant, tokens->$ Sankey showing batching/cache savings, and a small map showing regional median latency and $/k tokens.
Priya: Messaging: avoid superlatives. Spin: "predictable inference economics" + "graceful degradation under load." Lead hero: "Keep token costs under control while meeting latency SLOs."
Noah: I9ll do the csvs and a short methodology blurb for the appendix. Use "up to" ranges for savings.
Riya: I can do visuals and social crops. Horizontal 3-panel layout so it becomes a slide and a social card. Color palette: teal + slate + orange accent for tail.
Maya: Routing: SMB -> trial flow; Mid-market -> webinar + playbook; Enterprise -> demo + privacy one-pager. Add UTM: utm_campaign=bench_webinar&utm_segment={seg}. Route Enterprise leads to AE queue when intent_score > 65.
Priya: Two social variants: product (short): "See one API keep latency predictable while trimming token spend. Wed 11am PT. Register:" business (longer): "Reduce inference spend without sacrificing SLAs	6 mins of benchmarks + playbook." 20-word blurb: "Real-workload benchmarks and tactics to cut inference spend while preserving latency SLOs	6 mins, routing, and cost playbooks."
Ethan: I'll post CSVs and sample queries by EOD. Will tag per-workload notes (dialogue vs retrieval).
Riya: Figma link incoming. I'll annotate how the Sankey computes "saved tokens" (batching + prefix cache).
Maya: Timeline: Ethan data EOD, Riya mock tomorrow morning, Priya copy tomorrow EOD, assemble one-pager Friday. Owners: Ethan=data, Riya=visuals, Priya=copy. Thanks! :rocket:
